description: K₆Na₂MnH₂₄(WO₆)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.01 Å. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.37 Å) and three longer (2.42 Å) Na-O bond lengths. W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.16 Å. Mn is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share edges with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Mn-O bond lengths are 1.97 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.74 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one K, two equivalent W, and one Mn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent K and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent W and one H atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one K, one Na, and two equivalent H atoms.
